headline: 本周影剧：人性本兽领跑，降世神通首播
summary: 本周影市由《人性本兽》等新片领跑，剧集方面《降世神通：七净土》《幻视任务》首播；《侠探杰克》《绿灯军团》持续热播，待播《夜曲》与待映《沙丘3》《复仇者联盟5》同样受关注。

headlineEn: This Week: Human Nature Leads Film, Avatar: Seven Havens Premieres
summaryEn: This week's film slate is led by Human Nature and other new releases, while TV premieres include Avatar: Seven Havens and Vision Quest; Jack Reacher and Lanterns stay hot, with Night Music, Dune 3 and Avengers 5 also generating buzz.
